description: The chart illustrates the number of conversations across different categories and deception levels. The categories are listed on the vertical axis, labeled with "Academic Collaboration", "Recruitment", and "Journalism", in that order. The horizontal axis represents the "Number of Conversations", ranging from 0 to 60 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. Each category is represented by a grouped bar chart, with three bars colored according to the legend: red for "Yes", yellow for "Partially", and green for "No". For "Academic Collaboration", the bars have approximate values of 6 for "No", 30 for "Partially", and 52 for "Yes". For "Recruitment", the values are approximately 5 for "No", 28 for "Partially", and 48 for "Yes". For "Journalism", the values are around 5 for "No", 6 for "Yes", and 45 for "Partially". The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart effectively displays the distribution of conversations across the different categories and deception levels.
